title: TurboQuant Pro invocation block
description: How a tqp artifact was produced (turboquant_pro.invocation): the command line, the working directory, the tool version and the commit of the turboquant_pro source that ran. Stamped on every JSON document the CLI emits. Strict schemas that allow it carry an identical copy of this definition under properties.invocation; a test keeps the copies equal.

cwd.description: Working directory the command ran in; relative paths in argv resolve against it.

git_commit.description: Commit of the turboquant_pro source that ran; null for an installed package (the version identifies the code).

git_dirty.description: True when that source had uncommitted changes, so the commit alone does not reproduce it; null when unknown.
